guards.verdict_evidence: Owner decision 2026-10-22 ('nic nevyplňovat dvakrát'), but compared with the old look the re-confirmation of VOP/GDPR/guardian consent is skipped when returning to the same bike, and discount codes from an earlier draft are carried to another bike. Guarded by account ownership (bookingDraftForeign) and 'paid meanwhile' (lastConfirmedBookingProvider). Whether every carried item is re-validated in the form is outside this bucket.
guards.evidence: The consent check itself still exists (canProceedNow), but its default differs on re-entry: the v2 entry keeps the consents the same account ticked earlier for the same unpaid bike, so the customer is not asked again. Protections that remain: a paid booking in between or another logged-in account forces a fresh draft (booking_entry.dart:74-77, booking_carry_v2.dart:90-115); a different bike resets the consents. The code comments say this is the owner's "nic nevyplňovat dvakrát" decision (booking_carry_v2.dart:9-26), but by the task rule a changed default counts as WEAKER.

merged_situations.situation: Pressing REZERVOVAT starts a CLEAN booking draft: consents (VOP, GDPR, legal guardian) unticked, no promo/voucher codes, no delivery fees, gear sizes only from the profile, boots never prefilled (incident 2026-09-28). The booking form then runs all its validators.
Promo codes start empty on every new booking entry, so a code validated for an earlier draft is not silently reused.
In the old look every new entry into the booking starts with no discount codes, so each code is validated by the server right before it is used for this booking.

notes: mx-order-24: v2 carries already-validated codes into a later booking (possibly hours later or another bike) without calling validate_promo_code again. If the code expired or was used up meanwhile, the app still shows the discount; server behaviour at insert/payment not proven.
